name: Dimensional Prophecy of Zohar Redux Layer 2: Dasein and Difference
source: After Karala stayed at Hilals house and Hilal was attacked by a caine allen and crashed her car, karala hears something. It seems the caine are closer than she thinks. At the same time, another young woman with white hair Walls through the city. Pretty close to karala.
